english:
Receiving healing while below full HP grants the following to <solar Solar /> weapons for 4 seconds:
• 15 Handling
• 10 Reload Speed
• 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 25% Flinch Resistance

Any source of healing can activate the buff, including Orb pickups. <solar Restoration /> continuously refreshes its duration.

source.text:
2 Piece | Photogalvanic

Upon receiving ANY healing while not at Full HP:
+15 Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and 25% Flinch Resist for Solar Weapons for 4 seconds.
Works with ANY source of healing, such as Orb Pickups. Restoration constantly refreshes it
